user.description: Connect a Discord bot that keeps a chore board in a channel. The README explains how to create the bot and find the channel ID.

data_description.bot_token: From the Bot tab of your application in the Discord Developer Portal.
data_description.channel_id: Numeric ID of the channel for the chore board. With Developer Mode on, right-click the channel and choose Copy ID.

camera.title: Bin watcher (optional)
camera.description: Pick the Home Assistant camera that can see the curb (your doorbell, for example) and the nights the bins go out. Everything runs inside Home Assistant: snapshots never leave your network. Leave the camera empty to skip; you can add it later under Configure.

data_description.camera_entity: Any camera entity Home Assistant already has.
data_description.cans_nights: The evenings the trash goes out (the night before pickup).
data_description.recycling_weeks: Every week, or every other week by ISO week number (check one date on your collection calendar).

reconfigure.title: Change the bot token or channel
reconfigure.description: Paste the bot token again (Discord shows it only once) and the channel ID. The integration restarts with them.

data_description.bot_token: From the Bot tab of your application in the Discord Developer Portal.
data_description.channel_id: Numeric ID of the channel for the chore board. With Developer Mode on, right-click the channel and choose Copy ID.

error.invalid_channel: Channel ID must be all digits.

abort.already_configured: This Discord channel is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. The bot is restarting with the new settings.

init.description: Saving either page reloads the integration, which briefly reconnects the bot.

chores.description: Custom chores go one per line as: Name | emoji | every N days | note. Only the name is required, and a custom chore with the same name as a built-in one replaces it. {problems}

data.digest: Move the board to the bottom daily

data_description.disabled_chores: Ticked chores are left off the board.
data_description.digest: Re-posts the board once a day (silently) so it isn't buried under chat.
data_description.bump_after: When this many messages from people have pushed the board up, it moves back to the bottom once the channel has been quiet for a minute. 0 turns it off.
data_description.quick_reports: Up to five chores shown as one-tap buttons on the board. Tapping one flags the chore as needing doing now.

cans.description: Everything runs inside Home Assistant: snapshots never leave your network. The easiest way to set the region is to drag it on the Chores page in the sidebar; the numbers below are the same box. Changing the region starts the learning over.

data.cans_chore: Chore to tick when the trash is out
data.recycling_chore: Chore to tick when recycling is out

data_description.camera_entity: The doorbell or any camera that can see the curb.
data_description.cans_channel_id: Leave empty to use the chore board's channel.
data_description.roi_left: Percent of the picture's width from the left.
data_description.roi_top: Percent of the picture's height from the top.
data_description.roi_right: Percent of the picture's width from the left.
data_description.roi_bottom: Percent of the picture's height from the top.
data_description.cans_nights: The evenings the trash goes out (the night before pickup).
data_description.nag_time: On a bin night, look once more at this time and remind about any bin that isn't out.
data_description.renag_minutes: One follow-up if nobody answered and they still aren't seen out. 0 turns it off.
data_description.nag_mention: Optional user or role mention, like <@123456789> or <@&987654321>. Whoever claimed the bin's chore is pinged too.
data_description.bin_admins: Discord user or role ids (or mentions) who get the full working when they tap Check the bins: the snapshot, the region, confidence and buttons to teach it. Everyone else gets a read-only answer. Empty means anyone who can manage the server.
data_description.cans_chore: Marked done automatically when the trash is seen or reported out on a trash night.
data_description.check_interval: How often to take a snapshot in daylight.
data_description.asks_per_day: Most snapshots per day posted asking what you see. One extra is allowed on a cans-out night.
data_description.min_labels: The bot doesn't act on its own guesses until it has at least this many 'out' and 'not out' answers.
data_description.min_accuracy: And until it predicts its own past answers at least this well (leave-one-out).
data_description.confidence: Once trusted, a guess below this is treated as unsure (it asks instead of acting).
data_description.min_sun_elevation: Only look when the sun is at least this high (degrees).
data_description.min_brightness: Skip a snapshot whose region is darker than this (0-255).
data_description.recycling_weeks: Every week, or every other week by ISO week number.
data_description.recycling_chore: Marked done automatically when recycling is seen or reported out on a recycling night.

error.bad_custom: Some lines couldn't be read: see the description.
error.camera_required: Pick a camera to watch the cans.
error.invalid_channel: Channel ID must be all digits.
error.too_many_quick: Pick at most five quick-report buttons.

not_loaded.message: The Chores Discord Bot isn't loaded.

post_board.name: Post board
post_board.description: Posts the chore board again at the bottom of the channel.

mark_done.name: Mark done
mark_done.description: Marks a chore done, for automations (a robot vacuum finishing, say).

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The chore's name or key, like dishes or Trash-Ext.

who.name: Who
who.description: Shown on the board as who did it.

check_cans.name: Check bins
check_cans.description: Takes a snapshot now and posts it asking whether the trash and recycling are out.

preview_region.name: Preview region
preview_region.description: Posts a snapshot with the region the bot compares drawn on it.

reset_cans_model.name: Reset bin learning
reset_cans_model.description: Forgets every bin label (trash and recycling) and starts learning from scratch.
